test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the least number that must be added to the greatest 6 -digit number so that the sum will be exactly divisible by 294?
solution:
Given:

The largest six-digit number exactly divisible by 294

Formula used:

Required largest n-digit no. = [(Largest n-digit no.) – (Remainder left when the largest n-digit no. is divided by the provided divisor)].

Calculation:

The largest six-digit number = 999999

Now,

The largest six-digit number divisible by 294 

⇒ (999999/294)

Then, we get remainder = 105

⇒ 294 - 105

⇒ 189

The answer is 189.
